purpose: Manually observed BB3 labels paired with sanitized raw numeric extracts. Research evidence only; not proof of complete rule support.

source.privacy: Source filename, coach/team/player names, dates, account identifiers and arbitrary text omitted.

capture.method: Existing saved replay loaded into BB3 and stepped with Computer Use. This is not a newly generated hotseat replay.
capture.screenshots: Inspected inline in tool history; no screenshot files exported. Manual transcription is reviewable by replaying the hashed local source.
capture.locatorConvention: One-based EventExecuteSequence; zero-based StepResult and message array indices. UI team turns are cumulative 1-16.

limits: One source and one replay version; cross-source and version-held-out acceptance still required.
Labels and dice transcribed by the agent, not independently human-reviewed. Numeric verifier validates extracts, not semantic transcription.
Only annotated UI events were observed. Remaining raw messages are chain context, not separately confirmed semantic claims.
No mappings, scoring contracts or backlog items are promoted or closed by this fixture.

cases.notes: Home Catcher4 blocks away Norse Raider Lineman41. UI shows both ST3, two red/locked options while the home side waits, then away banner/Choose a result and Push selected. Raw first question has AttackerChoice0, GamerId0, CanChoseDie0 and CanUseTeamReroll1; second question hands selection to GamerId1, CanChoseDie1, CanUseTeamReroll0 with unchanged [2,3] pool and no RolledDiceIndexes. This repeats the pool for a controller handoff, not a new random attempt. Final selected Push has NewRoll1, which also cannot alone establish another rolled pool. Push destination/follow-up choices return to GamerId0. This single observed choice does not establish an optimal coach policy.
